newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Minproc enters into two new contracts.
newsitem.headline: Minproc enters into two new contracts.

text.p: Minproc Engineers Limited has entered into two major design and construction contracts for the Cawse Nickel and Abosso Gold projects, the company announced on Sunday.
The projects add a combined A$230 million of total installed cost and 160,000 hours of engineering work to the company's forward order book on a reimbursable basis, Minproc said.
The Cawse Nickel project is to be designed and constructed for Centaur Mining and Exploration Limited, in a joint venture with Kvaerner John Brown Pty Ltd.
Minproc's work has a total installed cost of over A$200 million and over 120,000 hours of work committed, the company said.
The Abosso Gold project is to be constructed in Ghana for Ranger Minerals NL for a total installed cost of over A$30 million and over 40,000 hours of work committed.

"These contracts confirm Minproc's world leading technical bankability and project delivery performance, to take the total order book to over A$500 million total installed costor over 500,000 hours," Minproc chairman Brettany Fogarty said.
He also said the contracts represented an important consolidation of the turnaround in Minproc's recent corporate and financial re-organisation.
